description.text: Dark Crystal Blaze (黑晶炽诚) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 12 September 2025 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. It is built around Tera Pokémon whose Tera type differs from their own type: Charizard, Terastallized to the Darkness type, is on its cover and in the set as Charizard ex. It also brought Larry and Poppy of the Paldea Elite Four as Supporters, among other Trainers, and its Pokémon ex include Garchomp ex, Mewtwo ex, Altaria ex, Armarouge ex and Hoopa ex. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. The Happy Set Altaria & Latios & Infernape & Maushold came out the same day. Its main cards are numbered out of 129; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 164.
